reading: With the hole closed the instrument reaches more code and rejects more, and the conclusion does not move: a specification read off structure alone rejects a real minority of behaviourally-altered variants (11.4% here) and is blind to roughly three quarters of them. It is a real oracle and a weak one, and the limit is vocabulary, not coverage.
why_a_new_receipt: The V1 measurement ran with a reduction that kept only the functions under test. A function that calls a helper therefore raised NameError and reported NOT_APPLICABLE for every law, and modules whose kept definitions named a dropped name failed to load entirely (43 of 121 in this tree). V1's numbers are not wrong so much as measured through a hole; V2 keeps every call-safe definition, falls back to statement-by-statement loading, and is the number to quote. V1 is left in the tree, unedited, because deleting an unflattering measurement is how a receipt becomes a brochure.
